Every visible human anatomically coherent: two arms, two legs, normal five-finger hands, hands preferably natural closed grips or outside crop. No severed body parts, gore or gratuitous torture. Skill targeting must be exact. Identity: severe elderly lean tan man, slick silver hair tied short at nape, angular lined face, pale high-collared coat with burgundy lining over black clothes, black gloves, diagonal strap of ivory theatrical mask trophies and old rectangular brass tags. These masks symbolize his trophies; keep this humanoid identity, never a giant literal head.
1 Portrait: waist-up three-quarter low angle, appraising gaze, one gloved fist resting on the mask strap, dim vertical archive behind.
2 Primeiro Troféu passive: side close action view of this man hooking his FIRST ivory mask trophy to his belt; small red spark marks one earned advantage. Focus face plus single trophy.
3 Laço de Caça: over his shoulder as he pulls one red hunting cord taut around ONE distant standing armored enemy's forearm; motion travels from hunter to target, no noose around neck. One trophy glints at his waist as a charge is earned.
4 Cobrança do Caçador: tight diagonal mid-shot of him driving one brass-tagged cleaver into ONE enemy's translucent red defensive ward; ward cracks first, enemy silhouette behind, physical follow-through.
5 Galeria de Troféus: high oblique wide shot hunter sweeping THREE mask trophies from his coat in one crescent around ONE enemy, masks break to ember dust as spent charges, open empty hooks visibly left behind. Not multiple victims.
6 Sombra do Colecionador: full-body narrow side profile hunter alone stepping sideways into a wall of his own mask-shaped shadow as ONE incoming attack passes through where he stood; shadow shelters ONLY him. No allies.
